# Dimension 3D Prints

> Professional FDM 3D printing service. Address: Rambla de Brasil 53, Barcelona. WhatsApp: +34 672 051 147. Website: https://www.dimension3dprints.com. Minimum order €10 (no setup fee). Shipping €5.90. Materials: PLA, PETG, ABS/ASA, TPU, Nylon, carbon-fibre Nylon composites. Instant price calculator on the homepage: upload STL/STEP/OBJ, get a quote in under 1 hour.

## Services

- [Homepage](https://www.dimension3dprints.com/) — file upload, instant quote in under 1 hour, service overview
- [3D printing service (international)](https://www.dimension3dprints.com/3d-printing-service) — English landing for customers outside Barcelona
- [3D printing Barcelona](https://www.dimension3dprints.com/3d-printing-barcelona) — local Barcelona service: quote in 1h, delivery in 24–48h
- [3D printing for business (EN)](https://www.dimension3dprints.com/3d-printing-for-business-barcelona) — invoice, NDA, €10 minimum order no setup fee; batch pricing table, free prototype offer
- [Impresión 3D para empresas (ES)](https://www.dimension3dprints.com/impresion-3d-empresas-barcelona) — misma oferta en español
- [Impressió 3D per a empreses (CA)](https://www.dimension3dprints.com/ca/impressio-3d-empreses-barcelona) — mateixa oferta en català
- [Short-run production (EN)](https://www.dimension3dprints.com/short-run-3d-printing-barcelona) — batches from 1 to several hundred units, tiered pricing, no setup fee
- [Tiradas cortas (ES)](https://www.dimension3dprints.com/tiradas-cortas-impresion-3d-barcelona) — lotes de producción en tirada corta, precio por tramos
- [Rapid prototyping](https://www.dimension3dprints.com/rapid-prototyping-barcelona) — 24–72h iteration cycle for engineers and startups
- [Urgent / express 3D printing](https://www.dimension3dprints.com/urgent-3d-printing-barcelona) — priority queue, 24–48h and same-day delivery for genuine emergencies
- [Custom parts](https://www.dimension3dprints.com/custom-parts-barcelona) — parts from STL/STEP file, photograph, or measurements; no minimum order
- [Prototype printing](https://www.dimension3dprints.com/prototype-printing-barcelona) — functional prototypes for startups, engineers, and design students
- [Replacement parts](https://www.dimension3dprints.com/replacement-parts-barcelona) — discontinued or broken plastic parts for appliances, furniture, vehicles
- [Returns and quality policy](https://www.dimension3dprints.com/politica-devoluciones) — what is covered, how to request a reprint or refund
